_comment: PIPELINE CONFIG (ACTIVE) — single source of truth for: grid sampling + Turbospectrum synthesis.
_howto: Edit this file, then run via scripts/pipeline_from_config.py or turbospectrum.pbs.
For sharded runs (no PBS arrays), submit multiple jobs or use the manual shard queue in turbospectrum.pbs.
turbospectrum.pbs reads outputs/runtime from this config; use env vars only for explicit overrides.

grid._note: Sampling + defaults that become columns in the grid Zarr (output_mode/calculation_mode/mode).

synthesis._note: These set wavelength grid + default output mode for synthesis.

zarr._note: Zarr grid chunking/compression; output path is controlled by outputs.grid_zarr.

paths._note: Leave empty to use repo defaults; set explicitly if your HPC layout differs.

_note: These are Turbospectrum defaults used ONLY when the grid does not include per-row values.
In the Zarr-grid workflow, lam_min/max/step/output_mode typically come from the grid.
If mode='random', pick mu columns from the Turbospectrum intensity .spec file and store them in the Zarr outputs.
reduce='first' stores one randomly selected mu; reduce='mean' averages over the sampled mus.
Linelist path/files and atmosphere path are read directly from turbospectrum.paths.
Checksums are auto-computed when files are accessible.

outputs._note: Primary output paths. turbospectrum.pbs reads these directly unless explicit env overrides are provided.

runtime._note: Optional runtime knobs consumed by pipeline scripts; PBS env vars can still override when explicitly set.
